methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: the article examines a variation of the in-house energy management system implementation and proposes an algorithm concerning the method preparation necessary for energy management system formation

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Economic/managerial analysis of reasons for low ISO 50001 adoption in Russia; proposes an organisational EnMS-formation algorithm but presents/characterises no EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The reasons of the low intensity of the energy management system certification of Russian enterprises were established in the process of this research.

stage1.notes: Incidentally names chemical/petrochemical/metallurgical sectors and Sibur (petrochemical) as EnMS adopters, but presents no EnPI/EnB model; ineligible so level_3b forced false.
